scripts.android: echo 'Android build requires manual setup. Please run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug'
scripts.android:install: adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.familyscreen.mobile/.MainActivity
scripts.android:device: DEVICE=${DEVICE:-$(adb devices | grep -v 'List of devices' | grep 'device' | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}')} && adb -s $DEVICE install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb -s $DEVICE shell am start -n com.familyscreen.mobile/.MainActivity
